title: Architektur
summary: Architecture of dimuli: two crates, one AppState, one data flow, with the collage-core data model, module responsibilities, platform trait, and v1 limits and constants.
notes: No frontmatter, no status field, and no ADR Context/Decision/Consequences structure. The 'Leitentscheidungen' table is a design-rationale list, not a formal ADR set.
